films.title: Sounds Like You Guys Are Crushing It
films.description: Polar Skate Co.'s 45-minute global team full-length was composed by Pontus Alv and filmed by Tor Ström. The complete first-party credits distinguish 13 featured riders from four guest appearances, while preserving five main filmers, 16 additional filmers, motion-graphics, sound-mixing and music-licensing credits.
creditNotes: Polar's official upload supplies the complete 13-rider featured roster, four guest appearances and every supported production credit retained here.
SkateVideoSite independently classifies the release as a 45-minute full-length, catalogs all 17 appearances and confirms Pontus Alv and Tor Ström as the principal filmmakers.
The Skateboarder's Companion independently repeats the featured/guest distinction and the principal and main camera credits.
Polar describes Pontus Alv's role as 'A Film composed by'; it is represented as the principal creative/directing credit without inventing a separate editor credit.
locations: New York City, New York, USA
films.locationNote: SkateVideoSite's section catalog explicitly labels Los Angeles, New York City and Copenhagen montages; no unsupported city list is inferred from the remaining footage.
films.historicalContext: Contemporary coverage presented the film as a possible final Pontus Alv-produced Polar video. It became the second of two consecutive Polar full-lengths filmed principally by Tor Ström before the company changed lead filmmakers for Everything is Normal.
films.artworkNotes: The exact official upload's 480x360 YouTube thumbnail was visually reviewed on 2026-09-15. It is a letterboxed landscape frame from the authorized film, with no misleading trailer, episode or event text; this upload exposes no max-resolution thumbnail.

aliases: RVCA's The Balance of Opposites Video
films.title: The Balance of Opposites
films.description: RVCA's 30-minute company full-length gathers footage from skate-team trips around the world between fall 2017 and summer 2019. Directed by Austin Stephens, produced by PM Tenore, filmed by Brandon Jensen and Don Luong and edited by Jensen, it preserves the complete ten-rider roster across dedicated parts, montages and shared sections.
creditNotes: RVCA's first-party film and premiere pages supply the full ten-rider roster, the global filming window and the company's positioning of the release as its first skate full-length in more than five years.
An independent contemporary Bordeaux screening program explicitly credits Austin Stephens as director, PM Tenore as producer, Brandon Jensen and Don Luong as filmers, and Jensen as editor.
SkateVideoSite independently classifies the film as a 29-minute 2019 RVCA full-length, confirms Jensen and Luong and catalogs all ten skaters.
films.locationNote: The authorized Thrasher upload describes the journey as spanning the United States, the Middle East and Australia; RVCA describes the source footage as global team trips from fall 2017 through summer 2019.
films.historicalContext: RVCA described The Balance of Opposites as its first full-length skate video in more than five years. It was assembled from almost two years of international team trips before premiering at RVCA headquarters in 2019.
premiereNotes: RVCA documents a packed 2019 premiere at company headquarters; a free Bordeaux screening followed on December 12, 2019.
films.artworkNotes: The official 1920x1080 YouTube max-resolution thumbnail was visually reviewed on 2026-09-15. It is a dedicated RVCA title card over an action photograph from the film's Middle East footage and matches the exact authorized player.
